notes.title: Battlerace - Update #5.12.4
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are releasing update 5.12.4, which includes several improvements and fixes that we have prepared for you.

Thank you,
TieDeveloper

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

[h1]Update #5.12.4[/h1]


[h2]What do we bring with Update 5.12.4?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Operator selection window has been improved
[*] The number of bullets in the Glock 17 magazine has been corrected
[*] Damage of Bullpup .50 BMG, Milkor MGL, and ICS-190 MGL weapons has been corrected
[*] Item prices in the game store have been corrected
[*] Maximum AFK time has been corrected
[*] Suppressor names have been corrected
[*] The player adding system to the friends list has been fixed.
[/list]


[h2]Weapons[/h2]
We are introducing several changes to the weapons in the game. In the case of the Bullpup .50 BMG, it has been decided to reduce its damage from 85/100 to 45/100. The Milkor MGL and ICS-190 MGL grenade launchers have also received improvements, increasing their damage to 90/100 and 82/100, respectively. At the same time, to prevent the abuse of these weapons, the available ammunition has been reduced to a single drum. This was done to balance their power in the game and prevent them from being too dominant in combat. Of course, as always, we rely on the feedback of the players and will closely monitor their reactions to the changes.

We have also increased the amount of ammunition in the Glock 17 weapon from 16 to 17 bullets per magazine.

We have made changes to the nomenclature of suppressors. Previously, generic names such as "Suppressor 1" were used, but we have decided to enhance this aspect of the game by introducing more detailed and precise names.

Now, players will be able to see new names for suppressors that will describe their features and specifications in greater detail. We believe that this change will improve the quality of the game, facilitate players in choosing the best suppressor for their playstyle, and provide better gameplay experiences.


[h2]Store[/h2]
We have improved the prices of all items that can be purchased in the game. After a thorough review and analysis of our prices, we have noticed that they require improvement.

Therefore, we have introduced optimized and correct prices that are more adequate to the value of items.

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
We have fixed the system for adding players to friends. Previously, players encountered an error that limited them to adding only one friend. This was inconvenient for many players who wanted to establish more friendships and build a larger community in the game.

After a thorough review and analysis of the problem, we were able to find a solution and fix the error. Now, players can add more than one friend and enjoy greater freedom in building relationships with other players.


[h2]Player[/h2]
We have extended the maximum AFK time. Previously, this time was 120 seconds, but we have decided to increase it to 270 seconds.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

notes.title: Battlerace - Update #5.11.4
notes.content:
Hello players,

On April 1st at 8:00 AM UTC, we will release update 5.11.4, which includes many new features, improvements, and fixes that we have prepared for you.

Thank you,
TieDeveloper

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

[h1]Update #5.11.4[/h1]


[h2]What do we bring with Update 5.11.4?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a sighting customization system
[*] Added a Floating text effect
[*] Added more settings
[*] Added Flooded Grounds map
[*] Added "Viper crossbow" weapon
[*] Added 10 weapon skins
[*] Added 25 emblems
[*] Added 10 player cards
[*] Added 4 operator skins
[*] Improved AI pathfinding
[*] Improved store window
[*] Improved lighting on maps
[*] Improved scrolling speed of the skin list in weapon customization
[*] Improved the placement of sight previews on AWM in weapon customization
[*] Improved mouse control in menu windows
[*] Improved emblem images: Arenas, Guanaco Desert, Training Ground
[*] Improved weapon range
[*] Improved third-person weapon holding
[*] Improved sniper aiming system
[*] Improved M8879 weapon damage
[*] Improved user account security
[*] Fixed game store errors
[*] Fixed login screen errors
[*] Fixed voucher errors
[*] Fixed "Gun race" game mode errors
[*] Fixed display of the "camo" button that expands the skin list in weapon customization
[*] Fixed an issue with item purchase blocking
[*] Updated Unity engine to version 2021.3.21f1 from version 2021.3.17f1.
[/list]


[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
One of the most important changes is the improved mouse control in menu windows. Now the mouse cursor works much smoother and more precisely, allowing for faster and more intuitive navigation through the menu and selecting options.

In addition, a number of other improvements and fixes have been introduced to enhance the game interface.

[list]
[h3]Store[/h3]
We have made several minor improvements to the game store window. Although these are not major changes, they have had a positive impact on the quality of the user interface.

We have fixed some voucher-related issues and added some important features to the system, allowing us to give you more in-game items.

We have also fixed a bug that prevented users from purchasing items when they already had 31 items in their collection. This bug was caused by security measures that were originally intended to protect users (That protected you so much that it didn't even let you buy things xD).


[h3]Weapons Customization[/h3]

We are introducing some important changes to the weapon customization window. The scrolling speed of the weapon skins list has been improved, allowing players to choose the right skin for their weapon more easily and quickly.

Additionally, we have improved the positioning of the AWM weapon sight preview, allowing players to better familiarize themselves with the appearance and functionality of the sight.

Furthermore, we have also fixed the display of the "Camo" button, which now works properly and enables easy selection of the appropriate skins for weapons.


[h3]Settings[/h3]
We have redesigned the settings window with a new interface layout and color schemes that improve readability and ease of use, positively affecting user comfort. The window is now more intuitive and transparent, allowing players to quickly and efficiently navigate through different options and customize game settings according to their needs.

New graphics customization options have been introduced, allowing for even greater personalization of the gaming experience. Players now have access to additional options such as Motion Blur, Bloom, Film Grain, Chromatic Aberration, and Lens Distortion. Each of these settings enables adjustment of the game image to individual player preferences, affecting visual quality and gameplay fluidity.

We are adding even more game customization options, such as UI crosshair personalization and Floating Text effect.

The crosshair personalization allows players to adjust the color, thickness, gap size, dot thickness, and more, giving them even greater control over the user interface and enabling them to customize it to their individual preferences.

The Floating Text effect displays damage text on the screen when hit, helping players quickly recognize the effects of their actions in the game. This option allows for even greater immersion in the game and a more dynamic gameplay experience.

Here is the appearance of the "Graphics" tab after sorting, improving the window, and adding new settings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/46328a7b13ef059914837d2ecb8ce7efc92396ba.png[/img]

Here's what the "HUD" tab looks like, where you can find the UI crosshair settings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/516f158b3cb6b6c4872c259d7c6645a59a214a45.png[/img]

Here is the appearance of the Floating text effect (check on the right side of the opponent, when we shoot, damage numbers appear):
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/DD96WSg/Untitled-video-Made-with-Clipchamp-Adobe-Express.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Login window[/h3]
We have fixed several bugs related to the login window interface and improved the security of user accounts.
[/list]


[h2]UI[/h2]
Many user interface improvements have been introduced, removing all errors and imperfections in the UI. As a result, the game runs much more smoothly and there are no longer any problems with displaying various interface elements.


[h2]Weapons[/h2]
"Viper crossbow" is a new weapon that has been added to the game, and it looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/f8fd12446a071c3056870e8e552ce0e2f581dfc3.png[/img]

In addition, a number of improvements have been made to the game mechanics to provide you with an even better gameplay experience. These changes include improving the weapon range and third-person weapon handling, which has had a positive impact on character animations. The sniper rifle aiming system has also been improved, making the game more realistic and challenging. Finally, damage has been adjusted in the M8879, which will balance the strengths of different weapons in the game.

The M8879 weapon now deals 65/100 damage instead of the previous 55/100.

As for changes to the weapon range, it now looks like this (before: value/maximum value -> after: value/maximum value):
[list]
Glock 17: 500/1000 -> 200/1000
M8879: 20/1000 -> 23/1000
SPAS 12: 20/1000 -> 26/1000
.44 Magnum: 300/1000 -> 225/1000
UZI: 200/1000 -> 215/1000
B&T APC9: 225/1000 -> 220/1000
Bullpup .50 BMG: 700/1000 -> 600/1000
UMP-45: 500/1000 -> 205/1000
STX .357 Magnum: 500/1000 -> 240/1000
KAC Stoner LMG: 280/1000 -> 310/1000
SCAR-H: 300/1000 -> 290/1000
AWM: 700//1000 -> 675/1000
M40: 700/1000 -> 730/1000
[/list]
Here is the changed sniper rifle aiming system:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/3993a2d3490cb8cb12077b4d67d7fd09b569c210.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/f3dc7b99920fbe44587b12fdcf29a2be3e03f6e9.png[/img]


[h2]Player[/h2]
We have made several fixes related to hand textures and third-person weapon holding. Additionally, several other minor adjustments were made.


[h2]Maps[/h2]
We have improved lighting on several maps, fixed the AI pathfinding, and most importantly, added a brand new map - Flooded Grounds!
[previewyoutube=kFAzYsSCp3g;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Game modes[/h2]
We fixed a bug in the "Gun Race" game mode that was causing the visible weapon change in third person to be incorrect - after switching to a different weapon, the view remained the same.

notes.title: Battlerace - Update #4.11.3
notes.content:
Hello players,

We would like to express our gratitude for all the feedback and suggestions we have received regarding our game. Thanks to them, we can constantly improve our product and provide the best possible gameplay experience for you.

On the upcoming Sunday, we will release an update to the game, in which we have prepared some changes and improvements. We also want to assure you that we will continue to work on enhancing our game to meet your needs and expectations. Therefore, we invite you to see what the latest update will bring.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

[h1]Update #4.11.3[/h1]


[h2]What do we bring with Update 4.11.3?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added dynamic background in the Main Menu
[*] Fixed UI bugs
[*] Fixed an issue with weapon fire rate
[*] Fixed automatic joining to rooms
[*] Fixed team member name tags
[*] Fixed player movement after the end of a match
[*] Fixed AI player detection
[*] Fixed projectile surface detection
[*] Fixed tag display
[*] Fixed ladder climbing system
[*] Improved UI windows
[*] Improved appearance of some windows in the Main Menu
[*] Improved graphics settings
[*] Improved head movement relative to character movement
[*] Improved range of knife noise sound
[*] Improved transparency of damage screen
[*] Improved player movement on uneven surfaces and slopes
[*] Improved trajectory and mass of grenade
[*] Improved ladder climbing animation.
[/list]


[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
The Main Menu has been changed, now featuring an even more impressive and realistic background. Dynamic clouds have been added, moving across the sky and adding greater depth and realism. A wind system has also been introduced, affecting the movement of the clouds and trees in the background, making the menu seem more interactive and dynamic. Additionally, old tree models have been replaced with new, more detailed and attractive ones, giving a sense of freshness and modernity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/4c4d924b49841857d8505d909da89546963ea555.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/1fb54607263742a17bed944c050add197cde444f.png[/img]

The settings, hosting, and waiting room windows have also been redesigned. New interface layouts and color schemes provide better readability and ease of use, which positively affects user comfort. These windows are now more intuitive and transparent, allowing players to navigate through various options more quickly and efficiently and adjust game settings to their needs.

[h3]Settings window[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/bef5c77bf0cfdcb0586f69a197c202992ab26dcf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/28cfd2d9c103ff166fd70882b334ad1d46f79bd6.png[/img]

[h3]Hosting window[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/876142161960e746f28f5735cfad10623a22111b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/cd63c57a8bb179196ebd7215a20d9026663ee09c.png[/img]

[h3]Lobby window[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/fde4eb1d03f30f2e9e1858ff79c0a0c1b1166f74.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/8f5555862304ce3627515381eb29140dc586c1a3.png[/img]

Additionally, a bug has been fixed that allowed players to join private rooms using automatic matchmaking. Now players will no longer be able to join private rooms using automatic matchmaking, which will provide better control over who can join private matches.


[h2]UI[/h2]
Many user interface improvements have been introduced, removing all errors and imperfections in the UI. As a result, the game runs much more smoothly and there are no longer any problems with displaying various interface elements.

In addition, the way the player damage screen transparency is calculated has been changed. Now it is calculated based on the damage received, allowing for more precise display of information about the player's health status. This means that the value of the damage screen transparency changes depending on the amount of damage received, instead of having a constant value.


[h2]Weapon[/h2]
We have fixed an issue with fire rate that affected all types of weapons. Previously, when we fired any weapon, it always started at the default fire rate, regardless of the fire rate we set later for a specific weapon. Now, each weapon retains its own fire rate, allowing for a more natural and realistic gameplay.

We also improved the range of the knife noise sound, which previously was the same as the range of gunfire sound. Now, the range of the knife noise sound is shorter.

Finally, we have improved the trajectory and mass of the grenade. These changes will allow for more precise throws and greater control over the grenade.


[h2]Player[/h2]
Many character improvements have been introduced. Firstly, player movement on uneven surfaces and slopes has been improved, significantly facilitating movement across terrain and enabling more realistic gameplay.

Another improvement was the animation of climbing ladders, visible from a third-person perspective. As a result, the game gained realism, and climbing itself became smoother and more natural.

Another significant change was the correction of an error that caused team member nameplates to appear in the sky when a local player respawned far from them. Now, players will be able to orient themselves in the game more easily and quickly find their team.

A bug that caused the player to continue moving after the end of the match has also been fixed.

We have also introduced an improvement in head movement relative to character movement, resulting in smoother and more natural character movement.

The last change was the correction of the ladder climbing system, which provided smoothness and realism in climbing and more intuitive controls. Thanks to these changes, players will be able to enjoy an even better experience in our game.


[h2]AI[/h2]
We have made a correction that allows bots to function better in our game. We were able to solve the problem that caused bots to not detect players in some situations after they respawned. This was particularly troublesome for players who relied on bots in their match.

After many tests and analyzing the source of the problem, we were able to develop an appropriate solution that allows bots to accurately detect players after they respawn. As a result, bots will function as intended, and players will not have to worry about their absence in crucial moments of the game.


Thank you,
TieDeveloper

notes.title: Battlerace - Update #4.6.2
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Update #4.6.2 will be available on December 16 at 7:00 UTC. This update provides many new features, redesigned systems and fixed bugs.

Since we value your feedback on Battlerace, we decided to gather all your opinions and publish one big update.

We would like to thank you for your patience as we worked to get this update into your hands, and we look forward to your continued feedback once you are able to jump into the game.

We will keep you updated on what's happening in Battlerace via the @TieDeveloper Twitter account.

Thank you,
TieDeveloper

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

[h1]Update #4.6.2[/h1]


[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unity engine rendering system change
[*] Changing the version of the Unity engine
[*] Changing the name of one of the teams
[*] Changed the appearance and improved functionality of the main menu
[*] Changed the look and improved the functionality of the UI
[/list][list]
[*] Improved lighting in weapon castomization
[*] Improved map preview images
[*] Improvement of shaders at targeting instruments
[*] Improved lighting on maps
[*] Improved security of user accounts
[*] Improvement of map loading scene
[*] Improvement of the nameplate
[*] Improved AI
[*] Improve weapon animation
[*] Improving weapon weight
[*] Improving player speed
[*] Redesign of the Guanaco Desert map
[/list][list]
[*] Fixing walking on water by bots
[*] Fixing sliding by the player
[*] Fixing the display of the killer in the kill cam
[/list][list]
[*] Added automatic server region selection
[*] Added full support for controllers
[*] Added translation of the game
[/list]


[h2]Game engine[/h2]

[h5]Rendering system[/h5]
We decided to change the Unity engine's rendering system from "Built-in renderer" to "Universal Render Pipeline" which gives more options and is more future-proof.

[h5]Engine version[/h5]
We put the game project on a newer Unity engine, from "Unity 2021.2.11" to "Unity 2021.3.15f1." This gave us access to a more stable version of the engine and to new features.


[h2]Menu[/h2]

We improved the look and functionality and fixed some bugs in the main menu.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/jZXPqVy/NewMenu.gif[/img][/url]

Major changes:
[list]
[*] From now on, the server region is selected automatically with the first entry to the game and the setting to change the region is now in the general game settings.
[*] We have added a "Join random" button in the server list tab.
[*] From now on, the "Play" button on the first page of the menu performs the function of redirecting the player to the server list where there is a "Join random" button performing its previous function.
[*] We have improved the map preview images.
[*] From now on, you can control the controller in the main menu.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
We have redesigned the UI to make it cleaner and easier to use. Also, a very important change is that now we do not respawn automatically, but manually by pressing a button.

[previewyoutube=V873CWUo9-g;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Controller[/h2]
We have added full controller support. You can toggle the controls by going to the game settings and then the "Controls" tab.

Note: Please do not switch the control device if you do not have it connected to your device, this can cause numerous problems with the stability of the game.


[h2]Castomization of weapons[/h2]
We have fixed editing record errors and added lights for better visibility of edited weapons.


[h2]Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have reduced the weight of each weapon in order to make the player move more dynamically.
[*] We have improved some of the weapon animations.
[*] We have sped up the drawing of weapons from a soldier's inventory. 
[*] We have improved the shaders of targeting instruments.
[/list]


[h2]Soldier[/h2]
[list]
[*] Repair of slip function.
[*] Improvement of the nameplate.
[*] Improvement of some 3rd person perspective animations.
[*] Reduced the player's movement speed.
[/list]


[h2]AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixing walking on water.
[*] Improving the movement system.
[*] Improving the positioning of AI on the map.
[/list]

[h2]Teams[/h2]
We decided to change the name of one of the teams available in the game, from now on they are Delta and F.F.L


[h2]Maps[/h2]
We have improved the look of the maps by improving the lighting on them and adding effects, and redesigned one of them. We present to you the improved Guanaco Desert map!

[previewyoutube=fNu657Ek2D8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Game translation[/h2]
We have added a new system for translating our game into different languages, currently to choose from:
[list]
[*] English (primary language in the game).
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[*] French
[*] Russian
[*] Italian
[*] Polish
[/list] Over time, we will be adding other languages to our game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/c982dea6396fbd1611b41a15cd5ed27a21acf86c.png[/img]

notes.title: Battlerace - Update #2.1.2
notes.content:
Hello folks,

On July 27 at 8:00AM UTC we will be releasing update #2.1.2 in which we focus on providing new content and some fixes and improvements to the game.

___________________________________________________________________
Models and Textures for weapons by DJMaesen is licensed under CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Source: https://www.artstation.com/djmaesen
*Weapon textures have been modified*
___________________________________________________________________

[h1]Update #2.1.2[/h1]


[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 20 emblems
[*] Added 10 player cards
[*] Added 13 weapons
[*] Added 4 skins for players
[*] Added 10 weapon skins
[*] Added "Arena" map
[*] Added "Elimination" game mode
[*] Added system for changing the skin of the weapon
[/list][list]
[*] Improving the speed of leveling
[*] Improving spawns on the Training Ground map
[*] Improving of the Battle Ground map
[*] Improving killstreak notification system
[*] Improving the class customization menu
[*] Improving security of player accounts
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed small bugs in the UI
[*] Fixed some bugs in the player's movement
[*] Fixed new level displaying during gameplay
[/list]



[h2]Elimination game mode[/h2]

[h3]What is Elimination?[/h3]
Elimination is a game mode where two teams have to kill each member of the opposing team (players cannot respawn until the round is over) in order to win.
The team reaching the maximum number of winning rounds will be the match winner. Dead players can observe their teammates who are still alive.



[h2]Leveling system[/h2]

The level system has been changed so that the way to conquer newer levels is not too fast.


[b]Previous settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Score per kill - 50
[*] Score per head shot - 10
[*] Score for win match - 500
[*] Score per time played - 2
[/list]
[b]Present settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Score per kill - 30
[*] Score per head shot - 5
[*] Score for win match - 300
[*] Score per time played - 1
[/list]



[h2]Weapons[/h2]

We have added 13 new weapons:
[list]
[*] LR-300 PBR
[*] B&T APC9
[*] Glock 17
[*] SPAS 12
[*] M40
[*] UMP-45
[*] Milkor MGL
[*] Sawn-Off
[*] STX .357 Magnum
[*] Bullpup .50 BMG
[*] AK-47
[*] KAC Stoner LMG
[*] Bayonet M9 N-715B
[/list]
Other:
[list]
[*] Improved the size of weapons that fall from the player after death
[*] Improved grenade throwing, now grenades can be thrown one after the other
[/list]



[h2]Maps[/h2]

We have added a new map "Arena".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/61c5f98fadff8f202fb7a627a687f51c703acdb4.png[/img]


After many requests from you, we redesigned the "Battle Ground" map to make it a little smaller. Here are the results of our work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320853/798d8bea2c47f6e5e506a336cb08c62898d7efbe.png[/img]

Also, we made small adjustments on other maps.



[h2]killstreak notification system[/h2]

We have improved the kill notification system, now when a player eliminates the AI he will not be credited points for, for example, a triple kill. We did this so that the player does not create private rooms to gain levels.



[h2]UI[/h2]

We have made some minor UI improvements and redesigned the class customization menu.

[h5]Amendments[/h5]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the UI to freeze during a finished match
[*] Fixed a bug causing the "Equip" button to not disappear when changing a player's emblem or card
[/list]

[h5]Class customization menu[/h5]

We have redesigned the class customization menu to make it clearer for more weapons and to have them sorted by their type.



[h2]Player[/h2]

[list]
[*] We've fixed the bug that causes automatic running
[*] We removed the protection after the player's spawn due to the advantage of the player who had it enabled
[*] Improved SCAR-H weapon positioning from another player's view
[/list]


Thank you,
TieDeveloper
